title: AAPS BG/SG sync delay with BYODA
symptom: AAPS sync delay between BYODA BG/SG reading and AAPS displayed reading. AAPS picks up at 4 mins and doesn't update until 8/9mins, picks up old BYODA reading, just after AAPS update BYODA moves to latest SG reading. BYODA tab shows 5min intervals but at 4mins in arrears. At 9mins SG is struck through and 3 delta marks go blank, then it picks up the old reading and shows the 4min interval reading.
cause: Dexcom app sends data with wrong timestamp or late i.e. data received at 12:26:36 has a timestamp of 13:22:29.
fix: No solution from AAPS scope; suggested to reinstall BYODA or use xdrip.
